 what is the purpose fo the day selectors? A: Day selector is for edge cases where location needs to update hours temporarily or rev port times vary.

notes.text:
Pressing location opens a modified location selection sheet. This sheet will show saved and recent locations (same view as My Locations tab).

Sheet height is not adjustable, but user can scroll. The selected location receives a “selected” treatment.   Locations have limited functionality and information (NO location info, icons, CTA, etc).  Pressing a different location will select it and automatically close the sheet. No selected state to confirm.
